clips.title: The story
paras: The Guarded Thunderbrew Barrel rests in the cellar of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. It represents the prized stock of the famed dwarven brewing family, watched over day and night to keep thieves and rivals from meddling with their craft.

In the cold snows of Dun Morogh, few things are guarded more fiercely than good ale. Beneath the floorboards of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, stout casks of potent brew age in peace. The family takes no chances with their stock, posting watchful sentries like Jarven Thunderbrew right beside the barrels to ensure not a single drop is tampered with or siphoned off.

Dwarven brewing is as serious a discipline as smithing or mining. The Thunderbrews take immense pride in their proprietary recipes, particularly potent batches of Thunder Ale. Between greedy troggs creeping around Dun Morogh and bitter brewing rivalries across the Alliance, Jarven's vigilant presence ensures the family's liquid gold remains untouched until properly tapped.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This barrel of ale is guarded by Jarven Thunderbrew. As long as he's in the basement, no barrels may be disturbed.
